title: Schematify holds the decision log as internal nodes, superseding FORGER-SPEC.md section 1
context: FORGER-SPEC.md section 1 placed decisions in a separate application, outside the design graph.
decision: Move the decision log inside Schematify as a collection of typed nodes with append-only semantics and supersession tracking, making decisions first-class citizens in the design layer.
consequences: Decisions stay with the design they document; single source of truth for design and its rationale; agents can reference decisions from design nodes; abandons the prior Veistra CSV-based decision log for this application.
